description: This file contains theme validation functions for the Notesnook project, including theme schema validation, color value checks, and a flattening utility.

methods.name: validateTheme
methods.description: Validates a theme JSON object against required keys, ID format, and color value correctness.

methods.name: isThemeDefinition
methods.description: Type guard to check if a JSON object conforms to ThemeDefinition.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested object into a single-level object with dot-separated keys.
